name: datagate-mcp
description: Every DataGate telecom billing API resource, plus a local SQLite store and offline search the API can't return in one call.

datagate_api_key.title: DATAGATE_API_KEY
datagate_api_key.description: Bearer token from your DataGate account

datagate_client_id.title: DATAGATE_CLIENT_ID
datagate_client_id.description: ClientId GUID from your DataGate account. DataGate requires this in addition to the Bearer token on every request.

datagate_base_url.title: DataGate API base URL
datagate_base_url.description: Full API base URL. Leave blank to use DataGate's production endpoint (api.dgportal.net); set to DataGate's sandbox endpoint or a different host if needed.

datagate_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
datagate_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on DataGate requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

datagate_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
datagate_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile
printing_press_client_profile.description: Binds this MCP server to one tenant-gated client profile, so every call answers for that customer. Leave blank to use the profile configured as default_client_profile.
